## Objective
- Modify the existing Nightfall browser survival game into an SCP-themed game where the menu can be closed/minimized, graphics have substantially more detail, creatures are various SCP types, and the player can enter shelters for protection.

## Requirements
- Build a complete playable game / apply the requested change without asking clarifying questions.
- Menu must be closable and minimizable.
- Improve graphics/detail for the map, creatures, shelters, main character, and companions.
- Replace generic creatures with various SCP creatures.
- Shelter must be enterable by the main character and provide protection from SCP creatures.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (max 1280px wide) for checks and read only the latest one.
- Note reasonable assumptions briefly when finished.

## Decisions
- Keep the existing canvas 2D architecture and all current gameplay systems rather than rewriting.
- Menu window controls: minimize collapses menu to a reopen dock; close hides menu and either resumes an active run or shows the idle dock.
- Add a HUD menu button and pause-screen Main Menu button; opening menu pauses gameplay.
- Add enterable shelter state via `game.inShelter`, with reduced incoming damage while the barricade is intact and a cutaway/interior visual later.
- Add a separate shelter-panel Enter/Leave button plus E-key interaction; preserve companion recall via new shelter-panel button.
- Replace enemy types with SCP variants: SCP-610, SCP-173, SCP-939, SCP-049, SCP-096, SCP-106, SCP-682, with unique mechanics planned.
